title: Normalized exceptional counit lifts and the two cyclic outer Hom squares
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l different from its characteristic, and a normalized realization family R. Use the model spaces, native Weil categories W(T), common-stage categories C(T), derived forgetting U, realizations rho, ForgetModels and native compact support J of [def-sf-native-exceptional-forgetful-data]. Let X,Y be model spaces, VX,VY any ForgetModels, f0:X.base -> Y.base a separated finite-type model morphism, S any normalized coefficient system and c any compactification of its geometric base change. Write F adjoint G for its specified ordinary adjunction. For T=X,Y let P_T be the exact native Frobenius heart autoequivalence. Give normalized, natural, exact boundary families bX,bY for the cyclic derived Hom sequence of [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data]. Then there is a natural isomorphism a:J;VY -> VX;F with the following property. For each native L in W(Y), there are native H in W(X), e:VX(H) isomorphic to G(VY(L)), and d:J(H)->L such that VY(d)=a_H;F(e);epsilon. For every native K in W(X), there are additive equivalences pMinus from coker(1-T) on ordinary degree -1 Hom(K,H) to coker(1-T) on ordinary degree -1 Hom(J(K),L), and pZero between the corresponding degree 0 kernels. Here T is the actual cyclic action on Hom after derived forgetting. For every coinvariant z one has (J(bX(z));d).hom=bY(pMinus(z)), using the native full-subcategory inclusions on bX(z). For every native v:K->H and every invariant z whose underlying element is cyclicDerivedForget(v.hom), the underlying element of pZero(z) is cyclicDerivedForget((J(v);d).hom). No claim about the middle native Hom map is included.

proof.text: Fix the given ForgetModels. Native open/proper forgetting identifies the ordinary exact open extension and total right-derived proper image, their Frobenius structures, and their comparison on every derived morphism. Transport these functors through closureMap and the exact coefficient section presentations. The common-stage realizations are fully faithful with bounded constructible essential image, so restrict to that image and lift the scalar-normalized compact-support comparison to a. Compactification refinement identifies the operation with the specified S and c. Different ForgetModels are identified by their realization isomorphisms through the same fully faithful rho; no special choice of models is required.

On the bounded constructible underlying categories the ordinary F and G, their adjunction, and the invertible Frobenius mate satisfy the hypotheses of cyclicDerived_liftedCounit_represents. Exactness, boundedness, and the native full-subcategory identifications come from native open/proper forgetting and the constructible realization. The mate and invariant counit are the scalar-normalized ones. The normalized cyclic sequence is compatible with the exact open functor followed by right-derived proper image by its finite-composite functoriality theorem; closure and section equivalences preserve those normalized squares. Apply the generic lifted-counit theorem and transport its H, e, d and prescribed underlying counit equation to the native categories and given ForgetModels.

The same generic theorem supplies additive equivalences on the actual degree-minus-one coinvariants and degree-zero invariants. They are induced by the shifted ordinary adjunction: compose the left comparison with F of the input morphism, the canonical shift comparison and the shifted ordinary counit, using e to identify the ordinary exceptional image. Its equivariance lets it descend to the quotient and restrict to the kernel. The boundary square is the finite-composite square followed by boundary naturality under d, evaluated on quotient representatives. The right square is forgetting naturality with its canonical zero-shift comparison. Transport through the fully faithful native full-subcategory inclusions gives exactly the two equations in the Lean conclusion. Uniqueness of the normalized boundary allows the supplied bX and bY. These statements retain the degree-minus-one term and impose no faithfulness on native derived forgetting.

lean.statement:
theorem native_exceptional_counit_hom_squares (R : Family l D)
    (X Y : Space D) (VX : ForgetModel D l R X) (VY : ForgetModel D l R Y)
    (f₀ : X.base ⟶ Y.base)
    [IsSeparated f₀.left] [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left] [QuasiCompact f₀.left]
    (S : CoefficientSystem D l f₀) (c : Compactification (geometricMap D f₀))
    (bX : CyclicDerivedHomBoundary (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l X.base.left))
    (bY : CyclicDerivedHomBoundary (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l Y.base.left))
    (hbX : CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryExact _ bX ∧ CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNatural _ bX ∧
      CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNormalized _ bX)
    (hbY : CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryExact _ bY ∧ CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNatural _ bY ∧
      CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNormalized _ bY) :
    ∃ a : nativeShriek D l f₀ ⋙ VY.functor ≅
        VX.functor ⋙ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F,
      ∀ L : W D l Y, ∃ (H : W D l X)
        (e : VX.functor.obj H ≅ (S.ring.operation c .closed).G.obj (VY.functor.obj L))
        (d : (nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H ⟶ L),
        VY.functor.map d = a.hom.app H ≫ (S.ring.operation c .closed).F.map e.hom ≫
          (S.ring.operation c .closed).adjunction.counit.app (VY.functor.obj L) ∧
        ∀ K : W D l X,
          ∃ (pMinus : CyclicDerivedHomCoinvariants
                (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l X.base.left) K.obj H.obj ≃+
              CyclicDerivedHomCoinvariants
                (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l Y.base.left)
                ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).obj L.obj)
            (pZero : CyclicDerivedHomInvariants
                (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l X.base.left) K.obj H.obj ≃+
              CyclicDerivedHomInvariants
                (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l Y.base.left)
                ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).obj L.obj),
            (∀ z,
              ((nativeShriek D l f₀).map (ObjectProperty.homMk
                (bX K.obj H.obj K.property.1 H.property.1 z)) ≫ d).hom =
              bY ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).obj L.obj
                ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).property.1 L.property.1 (pMinus z)) ∧
            (∀ (v : K ⟶ H)
              (z : CyclicDerivedHomInvariants
                (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l X.base.left) K.obj H.obj),
              z.val = cyclicDerivedForget _ K.obj H.obj v.hom →
              (pZero z).val = cyclicDerivedForget _
                ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).obj L.obj
                ((nativeShriek D l f₀).map v ≫ d).hom)
